title: Festio Juniors Volunteer Guide
tagline: See it. Record it. Reconcile it.
introduction: Staff-only guidance for safe, calm child movements. Volunteers keep every handoff safe and smooth to prevent overcrowding. Use the same Festio account and the event assigned by your Admin. Parents do not operate Festio Juniors.

sections.title: Start on your phone
sections.subtitle: Home, Children, Scan, My shift and More.
steps: Open festio.events/juniors/ and sign in with your existing account. New staff create and verify an account using the exact email assigned by the Admin. Choose the correct event.

On desktop use Overview, Children, My classroom, Programme and More. On a phone use Home, Children, Scan, My shift and More. More groups tools under Daily workspace, Child movements, Team & operations, and Help & setup.
Use the theme button for light or dark mode. Open Account & app to install or sign out. On iPhone/iPad use Safari Share → Add to Home Screen; on Android use the browser's Install app option.
sections.check: Admin is full Juniors access within its assigned scope; Volunteer receives only checked permissions. Existing event/organization Admins inherit the appropriate access. A missing tool may be a permission restriction. Stay online: handoffs are not queued offline.

sections.title: Find the child once
sections.subtitle: Guest List owns the shared child and guardian identities.
steps: Search by child name, classroom or badge reference, or scan their existing badge. The general child roster stays hidden until a search; an explicitly opened support or movement queue shows its relevant children.
Scanning identifies and opens a record. It does not automatically record attendance, a movement or pickup. Confirm the child and the next action on screen.
Missing or incorrect record? An Admin or volunteer with Add/correct children & guardians permission adds or corrects the shared record. Search first and avoid duplicates.
sections.check: A badge identifies a child. It never proves that the adult present is authorized to collect them.

sections.title: Separate Platform check-in from daily drop-off
sections.subtitle: Follow this event's configured JP start date.
steps: For NCNMO Junior Platform 2026, Day 0 is Platform check-in; from Day 1, record daily JP drop-off. Follow the configured start date for other events. Platform check-in alone does not begin JP custody or complete screening.

Every JP day begins with a fresh drop-off after event admission. The linked guardian is prefilled; choose the adult actually present. For Another person, record their name, relationship and optional international phone number.
Verify the drop-off in person. Verify a sibling is 18+. Complete today's screening confirmation and physically issue/check the standard band before confirming drop-off.
sections.check: Yesterday's unresolved custody must be reconciled by an authorized lead before a new daily drop-off. A drop-off adult is not automatically a pickup-authorized collector; review that authorization separately.

sections.title: Confirm saved screening answers
sections.subtitle: Reuse information; confirm today's facts.
steps: At drop-off or screening, supported child-specific registration answers or previous screening answers are prefilled. The source is shown. A parent's own answers are not copied to a child, and another event's answers are not used.

Ask and complete any missing or unknown allergy/accommodation answer. Confirm saved answers with the adult today and change anything that is different. Tick I confirmed both screening answers with the adult today.

Every screened child needs the standard screening wristband before classroom arrival, including children with No for both needs. A Yes answer also sends the child to the corresponding support desk; both Yes answers require both reviews.
sections.check: Saved answers do not mean today's desk reviews or wristbands are complete. Daily clearances and band confirmations do not automatically carry forward. Do not assume a missing answer means No.

sections.title: Clear every required desk
sections.subtitle: One standard band; additional bands for additional needs.
steps: A volunteer with Support desks & restricted notes permission reviews each referral. Relevant saved details can prefill the restricted notes; review and update them before confirming.
Confirm the physical band for each applicable need. Standard only = one band; standard plus allergy OR accommodation = two; standard plus both = three.
Clear both referrals when both apply. Classroom arrival remains blocked until required reviews, bands and classroom assignment are complete.
sections.check: Medical details stay restricted to authorized staff. Do not copy them into guardian messages or general movement notes. A saved form never grants automatic desk clearance.

sections.title: Record actual classroom arrival
sections.subtitle: Headcounts follow the recorded location.
steps: Confirm the assigned classroom. If missing, ask an Admin or a volunteer with child-record permission to set it in the child's shared record.
Check the standard band and all applicable extra bands. Finish each support-desk review first.
Confirm classroom arrival when the child physically reaches the classroom. Reception, support desk and classroom are separate locations.
sections.check: Do not record a child in a classroom while they are still waiting at reception or a support desk.

sections.title: Complete Clinic and Other return cycles
sections.subtitle: Departure → return to JP → classroom or verified pickup.
steps: Choose Temporary departure: clinic or Temporary departure: other. Record the accompanying adult; Other also requires an internal reason. The account and time are recorded with the movement.
When the child is physically back, choose Return from clinic / other. With no recorded return, the child remains away in the headcount.
If resuming class, record classroom arrival. If leaving for the day, record the return first, then complete verified final pickup.
sections.check: Never use final release for a clinic visit or assume a child returned. Clinic, Other and Outing each need their own recorded return.

sections.title: Account for each outing attendee
sections.subtitle: Expected, departed, returned and awaiting-return counts.
steps: Under More → Outings, an Admin or permitted outing coordinator creates the named, dated roster. Search/select children, verify outing permission and create the outing. Changing the search keeps selected children.

A volunteer with movement permission opens the outing and uses Not departed, Awaiting return, Returned or All attendees, with attendee search. Scan outing badge or open the child. Confirm departure for that exact outing only on its scheduled date, after the child is in class.
Record each return when the child is physically back; the child returns to JP reception. Confirm classroom arrival if resuming the day. Review every outstanding child before closing the outing.
sections.check: Scanning opens a confirmation; it never moves a child automatically. A child not yet dropped off must complete the arrival steps first. Close reconciled outing is blocked while any departed child lacks a return.

sections.title: Authorize, verify and release
sections.subtitle: Collector permission and the physical identity check are separate.
steps: If No authorized adult collector appears, drop-off, screening and classroom steps can continue; final pickup remains blocked. An Admin or guardian-editor uses Review collector authorization, or Add authorized collector when no contact exists.

Review the linked adult or enter the correct guardian, verify adulthood and mark Authorized to collect this child. Admin access already includes guardian editing. To delegate it: More → Volunteers → Volunteers tab → select people → Set role & permissions → Add/correct children & guardians → Save.

At final pickup, choose an already-authorized, adult-verified collector. Verify the person present against that authorization and confirm the physical handoff before Confirm verified pickup. A different, unapproved collector needs authorized staff review first. Call/Email shortcuts, when permitted, open the device’s phone or email app.
sections.check: A drop-off record, typed name or badge alone cannot authorize pickup. Never bypass missing authorization. Return children from Clinic, Other or Outing before final release.

sections.title: Read communication statuses correctly
sections.subtitle: Recording a movement does not guarantee a delivered message.
steps: Guardian email/SMS notices are recorded for movements. Actual sending depends on the event sending switch, designated guardian contacts, SMS permission, provider setup and available credits.
Queued means waiting; Accepted means the provider accepted the message; Delivered requires a receipt. Missing setup, failures and uncertain outcomes need review before retrying.

Use Notifications when permitted. Practice events never send guardian or volunteer messages. Admins can review volunteer access emails, shift reminders and handover reporting in Volunteers → Coverage & messages.
sections.check: Do not promise a message was delivered because a movement saved or the provider accepted it. Restricted medical details are excluded from guardian transition messages.

sections.title: Record supplies issued and returned
sections.subtitle: Use the current inventory form accurately.
steps: Open Inventory and the correct item. Check available quantity before issuing supplies.
Record the action, quantity and responsible volunteer. Put the destination, such as Room A, and useful handover details in Note; the current form has no separate destination selector.
Record good-condition returns, damaged returns and lost issued items separately. Check the issue/return history. Only mark items returned when physically received.
sections.check: Inventory totals are not proof that a particular classroom returned its allocation. Keep clear responsibility and destination notes; reconcile against the physical stock.

sections.title: Arrive, count and hand over together
sections.subtitle: Volunteers keep the whole programme moving safely.
steps: An Admin opens More → Volunteers → Volunteers tab to add names, emails and optional phones in table rows. Choose Admin or Volunteer and permissions, save, then select people for classroom and shift assignments. Email updates can be requested; delivery is reported separately.

Open My shift and check in only when physically at the station. Before leaving, count the children together and review Clinic, Other, Outing and unresolved records. Offer handover to the assigned incoming volunteer.

The incoming volunteer checks in and accepts the current physical count. The outgoing volunteer then finishes the shift. Use Shift planner for reminder timing, repeat intervals, exact times and supported email/SMS/WhatsApp/MMS channels; non-email channels need appropriate contact/consent/provider readiness.
sections.check: Do not leave children without relief. An overdue shift remains on duty until checkout. Reminders are not attendance, and accepted email is not a delivery receipt. Finish active handovers before changing access or removing classroom assignments.

sections.title: Programme, classroom and gala sessions
sections.subtitle: One timetable; every physical handoff is confirmed separately.
steps: Admin: open Programme → Programme setup. In Groups & rooms, map Guest List age-group values to saved classrooms and save. In Source & sessions, review the linked Experience timetable and custody session hours.

Resolve the open timetable questions, confirm review decisions under Review & publish, then publish the approved source. Publication uses the existing Experience and Festio Live sync; it does not record attendance or custody.

Under More → Volunteers, assign roles, permissions, classrooms and shifts. My classroom shows assigned groups, current/next activities, checked-in staff and outstanding returns. More → Supervisor shows group coverage and live headcounts.

For guardian updates, enable Send guardian email and SMS for new transitions under More → Settings and save. Contacts, SMS permission, provider setup and credits are required. Review delivery under More → Notifications.

At gala, after daytime pickup, open More → Gala childcare and search the child. Review a fresh drop-off, select the gala session and verify the adult, screening answers and wristbands again. Confirm classroom arrival, movements/returns and final pickup separately.

When named sessions are enabled, choose the correct current session at drop-off. A child already in custody cannot begin another drop-off. Do not change historical sessions; preserve their audit trail.
sections.check: Draft preview is not publication. A timetable never proves attendance, a reminder never proves shift arrival, and a drop-off never grants pickup authorization.
